message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on beaded wire decorative wildlife ornaments. The candidate headings are:

- 7020.00 (other articles of glass)
- 7018 (glass beads and articles of glass beads, other than imitation jewelry; glass eyes; statuettes and other ornaments of lampwork)
- 8306.29 (statuettes and other ornaments, of base metal)
- 9505 (festive articles)

Heading 7018 covers glass beads and articles thereof, but its ornament provision is for lampwork ornaments. Ornaments made of beads on a wire frame are more likely to fall under 8306 or 7020.

Under 8306.29, ornaments of base metal other than plated with precious metal are classified in 8306.29.00 and carry the statistical suffix 8306.29.0000. The wire frame gives the item its structure and shape, and the beads cover it. The metal frame is probably the essential character, so I'm going with 8306.29.0000.

The alternative is 7018.90.5000 (glass beads articles, other), which I recall from rulings on beaded items such as beaded ornaments. Even so, 7018.90 covers "other" articles of glass beads, and beads strung on a wire frame to form an animal figure could well be classified there. Rulings on beaded wire butterflies and dragonflies have, I believe, been classified in 8306.29.0000, since the frame is the essential character. I'm staying with 8306.
